items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 어휘의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: Emily <u>received</u> an invitation from a museum.
Model airplanes were <u>hanging</u> from the ceiling.
She was the first <u>female</u> pilot in Korea.
It was so <u>ordinary</u> that the honeybee looked alive.
She was so <u>caring</u> that she helped many people in India.
items.explain: ④ 살아 있는 것처럼 보일 만큼 '자세한(detailed)' 그림이어야 한다. 원문: It was so detailed that the honeybee looked alive. ordinary(평범한)는 어색하다.
items.source: L6 본문 도입·첫 번째 방·두 번째 방 · L6 Express My Thoughts Write (④만 원문의 detailed를 ordinary로 바꿈)

items.stem: 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 적절한 것은?
items.box:
• We get off at the next ______.
• Their last ______ was the famous beach.
items.explain: stop: 정류장 / 방문지 (다의어).
items.source: L6 어휘 다의어 stop

items.stem: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것으로 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices:
하지만 권기옥은 포기하지 않았고 꿈을 이루기 위해 열심히 노력했다.
⇒ However, Kwon Ki-ok didn't give up and worked hard to achieve her dream.

그 방은 많은 책들과 곤충과 식물의 그림들로 가득 차 있었다.
⇒ The room was filled with many books and drawings of insects and plants.

나는 네 꿈이 이루어지기를 바라.
⇒ I hope your dream comes true.

그녀는 한국의 독립을 위해 일본에 맞서 싸우기도 했다.
⇒ She also fought for Japan for Korea's independence.

그는 항상 어려움에 처한 사람들을 도우려고 노력한다.
⇒ He always tries to help people in need.
items.explain: ④ '~에 맞서 싸우다'는 fight against ~. 원문: She also fought against Japan for Korea's independence.
items.source: L6 본문 첫 번째 방·두 번째 방 · L6 UC A-2 · L6 Express Our Thoughts (④만 원문의 against를 for로 바꿈)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.box: I can't ______ to see all the amazing things there.
items.explain: can't wait to + 동사원형: 빨리 ~하고 싶다.
items.source: L6 Get Ready B 표현

lines: Junho: Minji, what are you reading?
Minji: I'm reading this book My Life with the Chimpanzees.
Junho: Are you interested in chimpanzees?
Minji: Yes, I am. This book is about the life of Jane Goodall and her love for chimpanzees.
Alex: I read the book, too. She's an animal scientist ____ⓐ____ studied chimpanzees for many years.
Minji: You're right. She's the first person to study chimpanzees in the wild. She's my role model.
Junho: Wow, that's great!
Minji: Like Jane Goodall, I'm very interested in animal behavior. And I want to study animals in the wild and help them, too.
Alex: I hope your dream comes true.

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은? (문장의 의미와 어법 모두 고려할 것)
items.explain: 선행사 an animal scientist(사람) + 주격 관계대명사 who.
items.source: L6 UC C · 학습지 L5 Grammar Points 1

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답변할 수 <u>없는</u> 내용의 질문은?
choices: Jane Goodall은 몇 년 동안 침팬지를 연구했는가?
items.explain: 'many years'라고만 하고 정확한 햇수는 나오지 않는다.
items.source: L6 UC C

lines: G: Excuse me. Did you see my umbrella? I think I left it here.
G: It's green, and it has a brown handle.
M: Oh, I found it and put it in the umbrella stand.
G: Thanks a lot!
G:Girl / M:Man

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
choices: Where did you last see it?
When did you use it last?
Where did he hide the painting?
items.explain: 뒤에 색과 손잡이(생김새)를 답하므로 생김새를 묻는 말.
items.source: L5 UC A-3 (선지는 모두 교과서 대화문 문장 그대로)

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.explain: ① 여기(here)에 두고 갔다고 생각함 ③④ 남자가 찾아 우산꽂이에 넣음 ⑤ 언급 없음.
items.source: L5 UC A-3

items.stem: 주어진 문장에 이어질 대화의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
A: What are you interested in?

(A) A: I hope your dream comes true.
(B) B: I'm interested in space travel.
(C) B: I want to be an astronaut like Neil Armstrong.
(D) A: Oh, that sounds awesome!
items.explain: 무엇에 관심 있니? → (B) 우주여행 → (D) 멋지다 → (C) Armstrong 같은 우주 비행사가 되고 싶다 → (A) 꿈이 이루어지길.
items.source: L6 UC B (순서배열 보기로 문장 순서만 섞음)

lines: Junho: I can't find my new smartphone. Can you help me?
Kate: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll call you.
Junho: ⓐ<u>Actually, I turned it off.</u>
Alex: What does it look like?
Junho: It's black, and there's a brown bear character on the cover.
Alex: When did you use it last?
Junho: I turned it off before class. Then I think I put it in my backpack.
Kate: Let's look around the classroom.
(a few minutes later)
Kate: I found it! It was inside your textbook.
Junho: Oh, thank you for helping me!

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용으로 볼 때 세 사람이 대화 직후에 할 일로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: Let's look around the classroom.
items.source: L5 UC C

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 문맥상 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: Kate가 전화해 보겠다고 하자 전원을 껐다고 답함 → 전화해도 찾을 수 없다.
items.source: L5 UC C

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
B: Sumin, what are you going to do this weekend?
G: I'm going to visit the nature museum. ______________
B: That sounds fun!
G: Yeah, I'm so excited.
choices: I found it and put it in the umbrella stand.
Most of all, I don't like chocolate cake.
items.explain: 자연사 박물관에 가는 이유 → 동물에 관심.
items.source: L6 Wrap Up 1 (선지는 모두 교과서 대화문·본문 문장 그대로)

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 짝 지어진 것은?
items.box:
• We heard someone ____ⓐ____ on the door.
• The room was so dark ____ⓑ____ I couldn't see anything.
items.explain: ⓐ 지각동사 heard + 목적어 + 동사원형(knock) (학습지: We heard someone knock on the door.). ⓑ so dark that ~: 너무 어두워서 ~ (학습지: The room was so dark that I couldn't see anything.).
items.source: 학습지 p.12 Grammar Practice 2 C-2 · p.25 Grammar Points 2 A-4 (문장 그대로, 빈칸만)

items.stem: 글을 쓴 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
"Step into history, one room at a time."
Special Invitation
Dear Emily,
Welcome to the Historia Museum! Come and see our special rooms. Each room will take you on an amazing journey back in time.
Brave Pilot / Great Adventurer / Powerful Painter / Insect Lover
When: October 1st ― 30th
Where: Historia Museum in Dream City
choices: Emily에게 Dream City 여행에 함께 가자고 부탁하려고
items.explain: Special Invitation — 박물관 초대장.
items.source: L6 Understand Visuals (초대장)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: Hi! I'm a wise detective, Mr. Owl. I can solve any problem. Today, a famous painting in the museum disappeared. Oh, there are footprints on the floor. The person who stole the painting is Mr. Roberts. Look at his shoes. You can see ______ on them.
items.explain: 바닥에 발자국이 있고, 신발에 진흙(mud)이 묻어 있다.
items.source: L5 Express Our Thoughts (Mr. Owl)

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아 <u>어색한</u> 곳은?
items.box: I think the person who stole the painting is Mr. Roberts. ⓐ<u>The first clue is his shoes.</u> ⓑ<u>I see mud on them.</u> ⓒ<u>There are footprints on the floor.</u> ⓓ<u>My dream is to become an astronaut like him.</u> ⓔ<u>The second clue is his long coat.</u> I think he can hide the painting in it.
items.explain: 도둑의 단서를 말하는 글에 우주 비행사가 꿈이라는 ⓓ(L6 UC A-2 문장)는 흐름에 맞지 않는다.
items.source: L5 Express My Thoughts Write (ⓓ는 L6 UC A-2 문장을 일부러 끼워 넣음)

items.stem: 우리말 뜻과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열할 때 <u>네 번째</u>에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
우리는 누군가가 문을 두드리는 것을 들었다.
( heard, knock, someone, on the door, we )
items.explain: We heard someone knock on the door. → 네 번째 knock.
items.source: 학습지 L5 Grammar Practice 2 C-2

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: I saw him cross the street.
They heard a girl laughing loudly.
Nick smelled something to burn in the kitchen.
She saw a cat climbing the tree.
items.explain: ④ 지각동사 smelled의 목적격 보어는 동사원형/현재분사(burn/burning). to부정사는 쓸 수 없다. (학습지 원문: Nick smelled something burning in the kitchen.)
items.source: 학습지 p.16 Grammar Points 2 예문 4개 · C-1 고친 문장 (④만 burning을 to burn으로 바꿈)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말끼리 짝 지어진 것은?
items.explain: The cookies는 동작을 받는 쪽이므로 수동태(were baked / were made / were eaten). 능동 baked·ate는 by him과 어울리지 않는다.
items.source: 선생님 제작 문장 · 학습지 L6 Grammar Points 1(수동태)

items.stem: 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는? (대소문자 구별하지 않음)
items.box:
People Who Make a Difference
• Mother Teresa: She ______ many people in India.
• Kim Dohun, Mina's Uncle: He is a police officer. He always tries to help people in ______.
• Antoni Gaudi: He was so ______ that he made beautiful buildings.
• Ms. Lee, Our School Nurse: She is so ______ that her patients always feel comfortable.
items.explain: She helped many people / people in need / so creative that / so kind that. ordinary는 들어갈 곳이 없다.
items.source: L6 Express Our Thoughts (People Who Make a Difference)

lines: Her first stop was a room that looked like an old airplane garage. Model airplanes were hanging from the ceiling. A leather pilot jacket and goggles were displayed. When Emily put them on, she could hear the sounds of airplane engines. She looked around the room ⓐ<u>in surprise</u>. On the wall, there was a picture of a woman. She looked brave and strong. Her name was Kwon Ki-ok. She was the first female pilot in Korea. Emily also found an old newspaper on the desk. It read, "At that time, women couldn't enter flight schools." "However, Kwon Ki-ok didn't ____ⓑ____ and worked hard to achieve her dream." Kwon Ki-ok did not just fly airplanes. She also fought against Japan for Korea's independence. Emily was moved by the great life story of Kwon Ki-ok.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?
items.explain: in surprise: 놀라서.
items.source: L6 본문 첫 번째 방 · L6 어휘 숙어

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 포기하지 않고 열심히 노력했다 → didn't give up.
items.source: L6 본문 첫 번째 방

lines: Today was Dad's birthday. As a secret gift, Mom baked him a cake. She wrapped the cake in a box and put it on the table in the kitchen. Then she went out to buy candles at 11. When she came back home one hour later, she found that the box was empty. Someone ate the whole cake!

Mom called Ms. Jones to find the person ____ⓐ____ ate the cake. Ms. Jones was a wise old lady who lived next door. Everyone in town came to her when they were in trouble. Ms. Jones came with her sweet smile. "Don't worry!" "Let's find out the big eater!" She asked Mom, "Who was in the house this morning?" "My children, Harry, Carol, and Tom."

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 선행사 the person(사람) + 주격 관계대명사 who.
items.source: L5 본문 도입 · 학습지 L5 Grammar Points 1

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 엄마는 케이크를 상자에 포장해 주방 식탁 위에 두었다.
Ms. Jones는 마을에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에 살았다.
items.explain: ① 아빠 생신 ③ 11시 ④ 옆집 ⑤ 상냥한 미소.
items.source: L5 본문 도입

items.stem: 다음 문장 (A)~(E)에 대해 바르게 설명한 사람만을 <보기>에서 <u>모두</u> 고른 것은?
items.box:
(A) The cake (A)<u>which</u> smells delicious is on the table.
(B) She (B)<u>was wrapped</u> the cake in a box and put it on the table in the kitchen.
(C) We heard someone (C)<u>knock</u> on the door.
(D) The cookies (D)<u>were baked</u> by him.
(E) She was (E)<u>so</u> hungry <u>that</u> she ordered two burgers.

<보기>
ⓐ 수연 : (A)는 선행사 The cake가 사물이고 관계대명사절의 주어 역할이니까 which를 쓸 수 있어.
ⓑ 예지 : (B)는 She가 포장하는 동작을 직접 한 것이니까 wrapped로 고쳐야 해.
ⓒ 민수 : (C)는 지각동사 heard 뒤에 오니까 to knock으로 고쳐야 해.
ⓓ 지현 : (D)는 쿠키가 '구워진' 것이니까 were baked가 맞아.
items.explain: (A) 선행사 The cake(사물) → which ○. (B) She가 포장한 주체 → wrapped(능동) (본문 원문: She wrapped the cake in a box …). (C) 지각동사 heard + 동사원형 knock ○(민수 ✗). (D) 쿠키가 구워진 것 → were baked ○. (E) so ~ that ○.
items.source: 학습지 p.15 B-1 · L5 본문 도입(wrapped를 was wrapped로 바꿈) · 학습지 p.12 C-2 · p.21 A-1 · p.17 C-3
